Name: Happy Hen Co. Mail
Author: januarywren
Description:
[center]Hi everyone! If you love chickens and want to enhance your #cottagecore aesthetic, this mod is for you. -:) You'll receive a weekly letter from the 'Happy Hen Co.' magazine that highlights amusing and real facts about chickens... + a small gift!

[quote][i]"Dear [Player],

Thank you for subscribing to the 'Happy Hen Co.' magazine! The Happy Hen Co. is dedicated to celebrating the wonderful world of chickens, and those who love them.

A new issue will arrive every week with true and entertaining chicken facts (and a small gift for you and your flock!). Your first issue will arrive soon - so keep an eye out!

From, The Happy Hen Co.

PS: Bonus issues of the 'Happy Hen Co.' may arrive over time as well...""[/i][/quote]
[color=#b4a7d6]Mod Content[/color]

Facts range from the amusing (hens have an egg-laying 'song') to the unusual (chickens can see color better than humans can!) to the downright terrifying (a phobia of chickens is known as 'alektorophobia'). 

Letters are scheduled to arrive on the [color=#ea9999]7th, 14th, 21st, and 28th[/color]! Letters are also set to deliver on 'secret' days (aka...near festivals and other special days...).

For *4 in-game years* the letters will be unique (regardless of when the mod is downloaded - i.e., if you install the mod in your 5th in-game year, then you'll receive unique letters until your 9th in-game year. Then the letters will start to repeat!). 

[color=#ea9999]Required Mods[/color]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API
[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod﻿[/url]﻿

[color=#d5a6bd]Mod Compatibility[/color]

This mod shouldn't clash with other mods however Mail Framework Mod will [b]*not*[/b] work with FeTK and Tool-Upgrade Delivery Service. 

[color=#ea9999]Credit
[/color]
A huge thank you to Lazarus for extensively bug-testing and helping edit, as well as Dimo and Abbadon_Abyss for beta testing! I couldn't have made this without you guys! 

[color=#b4a7d6]About Me[/color]

Hello! My name is January. I've loved writing ever since I can remember, as well as video games and modding. Modders, you guys are the best! I couldn't play Stardew Valley or Skyrim without you. Same to you, indie devs! 

If you are looking for a writer/editor for your modding projects, please send me a message! ??
